title: StaRSE: Compact Russian Sentence Embeddings with a Sign-Coded Static Encoder
abstract: arXiv:2611.14236v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer sentence encoders provide strong retrieval quality, but their inference cost becomes a bottleneck when embeddings must be produced on CPUs or refreshed frequently. We introduce StaRSE, a compact Russian static sentence encoder that removes Transformer inference at deployment time: token directions are stored as sign bits, token norms are stored separately, and sentences are encoded by mean pooling over norm-scaled sign directions. StaRSE is initialized from ruBERT-base, fine-tuned on Russian adjacent-sentence and task-shaped pairs, and post-trained with a contrastive stage that directly optimizes the sign-projected token table. On RuMTEB, StaRSE reaches a task mean of $51.16$, $7.98$ points above the strongest included static baseline. The packaged model occupies $11.3$ MiB and has a mean CPU latency of $0.08$ ms per sentence, compared with an estimated $55.7$ MiB 16-bit parameter footprint and $1.43$ ms mean CPU latency for

translated_title: StaRSE：采用符号编码静态编码器的紧凑俄语句子嵌入
translated_abstract: Transformer句子编码器提供了强大的检索质量，但当需要在CPU上生成嵌入或需要频繁刷新嵌入时，其推理成本成为瓶颈。我们提出了StaRSE，这是一个紧凑的俄语静态句子编码器，它在部署阶段完全去除了Transformer推理：词元方向以符号位形式存储，词元范数单独存储，句子则通过对范数缩放后的符号方向进行平均池化来编码。StaRSE从ruBERT-base初始化，在俄语相邻句子对和任务形态语对上进行微调，并通过对比学习阶段进行后训练，该阶段直接优化符号投影的词元表。在RuMTEB基准上，StaRSE达到了51.16的任务平均值，比所包含的最强静态基线高出7.98分。打包后的模型仅占用11.3 MiB空间，每个句子的平均CPU延迟为0.08毫秒，而相比之下，16位参数的模型估计占用55.7 MiB空间，平均CPU延迟为1.43毫秒。
tldr: StaRSE是一种紧凑的俄语静态句子编码器，通过将词元方向以符号位存储并去除Transformer推理，以仅11.3 MiB的模型大小和0.08毫秒的CPU延迟，在RuMTEB上实现了比最强静态基线高7.98分的检索性能。
en_tdlr: StaRSE is a compact Russian static sentence encoder that stores token directions as sign bits to eliminate Transformer inference, achieving 51.16 task mean on RuMTEB (7.98 points above the strongest static baseline) with only 11.3 MiB model size and 0.08 ms CPU latency per sentence.
